All 9 tests pass now (`node --test`). I changed only the source, in two places.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`:** the leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, so one payer too many got an extra cent. Splitting 900 across 3 gave `[301, 300, 300]`, which no longer added up to the total. It is now `i < leftover`. That fixed the "even split", "leftover cents" and "total is preserved" tests.

2. **`src/duration.js`, no validation in `parseDuration`:** it only looked for `<digits><unit>` pieces anywhere in the string. So `"10m and change"` was accepted as 600 seconds. I added a check at the top that the whole string must be one or more `<digits><h|m|s>` groups, otherwise it throws `SyntaxError`. That fixed the "rejects trailing junk" test.

The old "no matches" check below the new one can no longer trigger. I left it in to keep the change small.

I did this myself without delegating.
